subject: journal
variant_mechanics: A journal is a free-form record of things that happen in your housing situation - a call with the landlord, an incident you noticed, a request you made. Each entry saves a title, what happened, the date, and optional tags. Write it the same day if you can; short and factual is fine. Journal entries are saved for you alone.
variant_trust: A written note made close to the event is more reliable than memory weeks later, and a series of notes can show a pattern an advocate or attorney can use.
variant_reinforcement: Add a short note each time something relevant happens - date, what happened, who was involved.

subject: law_library
variant_mechanics: The law library lets you look up a Minnesota statute by number or keyword and read the official text and citation. Use it to see the actual rule rather than relying on a summary. Semptify shows the statute text; it does not interpret the law for your situation or give legal advice.
variant_trust: Reading the actual statute text is the most reliable way to check what the law says. Summaries can be incomplete or wrong; the statute is the source.
variant_reinforcement: Look up the exact statute number and read the official text before acting on a summary.
